mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio (user_id, sid, quantity, avg_price, total_amount, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sid}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}, #{totalAmount},#{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolio SET quantity = #{quantity}, avg_price = #{avgPrice}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}
mapper.select: SELECT p.sid, p.quantity, p.avg_price AS avgPrice, sd.current_price AS currentPrice, (sd.current_price - p.avg_price) * p.quantity AS evalProfit, ROUND((sd.current_price - p.avg_price) / NULLIF(p.avg_price, 0) * 100, 2) AS profitRate FROM portfolio p JOIN stock_detail sd ON sd.sid = p.sid AND sd.trade_date = ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_detail WHERE sid = p.sid ) WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.quantity > 0
SELECT pid, user_id, sid, quantity, avg_price, total_amount, updated_at FROM portfolio WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}
